description: Look up typical US consumer fee ranges (min/max per charge, USD) for one category such as bank_overdraft, or the full 14-category table when category is omitted. Use to answer 'is this fee normal?' questions. To check a user's own list of fees against these ranges, use audit_fees.

category.description: Category key (case-insensitive; spaces/hyphens become underscores), one of: bank_overdraft, bank_monthly_maintenance, atm_out_of_network, late_payment, gym_membership_monthly, streaming_monthly, airline_checked_bag, airline_seat_fee, ticket_convenience, rental_application, subscription_app_monthly, delivery_fee, airline_change_fee, hotel_resort_fee. Omit to get the full table; an unknown key returns an error listing valid keys.
